raise-error.description: #['Checksum mismatch for ' ++ vars.arc.fileName ++ ': expected ' ++ vars.arc.expectedChecksum ++ ' got ' ++ vars.arc.actualChecksum]

db:select.doc:name: Already archived?
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM compliance_report_archive WHERE run_id = :runId AND file_type = :fileType

logger.doc:name: AUDIT overwrite attempt
logger.message: #['ARCHIVE_OVERWRITE_REJECTED runId=' ++ vars.arc.runId ++ ' fileType=' ++ vars.arc.fileType ++ ' fileName=' ++ vars.arc.fileName ++ ' correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

raise-error.description: #['Archived file already exists and can never be overwritten: ' ++ vars.arc.fileName]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert chunk
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO compliance_report_archive (run_id, file_type, chunk_no, file_name, content, file_size, checksum) VALUES (:runId, :fileType, :chunkNo, :fileName, :content, :fileSize, :checksum)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: vars.arc.runId, fileType: vars.arc.fileType, chunkNo: payload.chunkNo, fileName: vars.arc.fileName, content: payload.content, fileSize: vars.arc.fileSize, checksum: vars.arc.actualChecksum }]

logger.doc:name: AUDIT archived
logger.message: #['ARCHIVED runId=' ++ vars.arc.runId ++ ' file=' ++ vars.arc.fileName ++ ' bytes=' ++ (vars.arc.fileSize as String) ++ ' chunks=' ++ (sizeOf(vars.arc.chunks) as String) ++ ' sha256=' ++ vars.arc.actualChecksum]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { runId: vars.arc.runId, fileType: vars.arc.fileType, fileName: vars.arc.fileName, fileSize: vars.arc.fileSize, checksum: vars.arc.actualChecksum, chunks: sizeOf(vars.arc.chunks), createdAt: now() >> "Asia/Kolkata" as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"} }

db:select.doc:name: List archived files
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, file_type, file_name, MAX(file_size) AS file_size, MAX(checksum) AS checksum, COUNT(*) AS chunks, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS created_at FROM compliance_report_archive WHERE (:fileName IS NULL OR file_name = :fileName) AND (:runId IS NULL OR run_id = :runId) GROUP BY run_id, file_type, file_name ORDER BY MIN(created_at), run_id, file_type

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map { runId: $.run_id, fileType: $.file_type, fileName: $.file_name, fileSize: $.file_size as Number, checksum: $.checksum, chunks: $.chunks as Number, createdAt: $.created_at }

db:select.doc:name: Select chunks
db:select.db:sql: SELECT chunk_no, content, file_name, file_size, checksum, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS created_at FROM compliance_report_archive WHERE run_id = :runId AND file_type = :fileType ORDER BY chunk_no

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toBase64 from dw::core::Binaries output application/json var first = payload[0] --- { runId: vars.arcKey.runId, fileType: vars.arcKey.fileType, fileName: first.file_name, fileSize: first.file_size as Number, checksum: first.checksum, chunks: sizeOf(payload), createdAt: first.created_at, // every chunk except the last is exactly 3,000,000 bytes, so concatenating // the base64 of each chunk equals the base64 of the whole file contentBase64: (payload map toBase64($.content as Binary)) joinBy "" }
